content:
No, the capital of Australia is **Canberra**, not Sydney. While Sydney is the largest and most well-known city in Australia, Canberra was specifically chosen as the capital in 1908 as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne, the two largest cities at the time. Canberra is located in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT) and was designed as a planned city.

Sydney is the capital of the state of New South Wales, while Melbourne is the capital of Victoria.
